name: Animal Sciences Leadership Academy
org: K-State Department of Animal Sciences and Industry
what_you_do: Spend four days at K-State learning about livestock and careers. You do workshops and tours, meet professors and industry leaders, and give a team talk.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 9 to 12 who like livestock and related careers. Students from across the country can apply.
pay_detail: $50 fee to hold your spot, due only if you are accepted. A livestock industry group pays for the other costs. You pay your own travel.
deadline_text: 2026 applications were due April 30, 2026. The program page does not list 2027 dates.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application form on the program page. Questions go to the academy director at 785-532-1272.
notes: Only 20 students are accepted. You stay in campus housing with program staff.
